items.html: And afterward come the mochin of the aspect of the Panim of his and of hers; and then her Panim are given to her by him, and his Panim remain in him. And just as she takes the Achoraim first through him and afterward through Ima, so too in the aspect of the Panim: first through him, and afterward through Ima, as is known. And know that all this is from their own aspects; but it is possible that even the Achoraim of the Malchut of Aba and Ima, in the aspect of their number, are the aspect of Panim to ZA himself. And this is understood.
